verdict.rationale: Marqeta is an API-first platform: its Core API creates cards, users, card products, and controls programmatically, so no UI is required. A sandbox with `/simulations/cardtransactions/*` endpoints lets automated pipelines exercise transaction flows without a card network, and webhooks deliver events to the user's own endpoint. Missing for 10: explicit CI/headless automation guidance, an official CLI or SDK for scripted use, documented credential handling for CI, and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404).
